item.title: Bank of England raises interest rates to 4%, first rise since 2023
item.body: The Bank of England has raised interest rates to 4%, its first increase since 2023. Its forecast shows inflation is expected to rise to a peak of 5% next year.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📈 Bank of England raises interest rates to 4%, first rise since 2023

The Bank of England has raised interest rates to 4%, its first increase since 2023. Its forecast shows inflation is expected to rise to a peak of 5% next year.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 5 November, 12:50
